cards.ex: Falling behind on payments can quickly lead to a debt spiral that's hard to escape.
cards.exUz: To'lovlarni kechiktirish tezda qutulish qiyin bo'lgan qarz girdobiga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni to'lash uchun yangi qarz olish holati, ahvolning yomonlashuvi.

cards.ex: The bank decided to write off the debt because the borrower had no assets.
cards.exUz: Bank qarz oluvchining aktivlari yo'qligi sababli qarzni bekor qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni to'lash imkonsiz deb hisoblab, uni balansdan o'chirish.

cards.ex: If they don't find new investors, the company is likely to go bust.
cards.exUz: Agar ular yangi investorlarni topmasa, kompaniya bankrot bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biznesning bankrot bo'lishi, pul yo'qligi sababli faoliyatni to'xtatishi.

cards.ex: The company started cutting corners on safety to save money, which is dangerous.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pul tejash uchun xavfsizlikda xarajatlarni qisqartira boshladi, bu xavfli.
cards.uzDef: Sifatga zarar yetkazib, xarajatlarni tejashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The government is struggling to balance the budget after the economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Hukumat iqtisodiy inqirozdan keyin budjetni muvozanatlash uchun kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni daromadga tenglashtirish, defitsitni yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: It's important to live within your means and avoid accumulating debt.
cards.exUz: Qarz yig'maslik va imkoniyatga qarab yashash muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Daromadga mos ravishda xarajat qilish, ortiqcha sarflamaslik.

cards.ex: My goal is to be debt-free by the time I'm 40.
cards.exUz: Mening maqsadim 40 yoshga kirganimda qarzsiz bo'lish.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday qarzi bo'lmagan holat.

cards.ex: With rising inflation, many families are having to tighten their belts.
cards.exUz: Infliatsiya o'sishi bilan ko'p oilalar kamarlarini mahkam bog'lashga majbur bo'lishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni qisqartirish, tejamkorlik qilish.

cards.ex: The unexpected medical bills became a significant financial burden for the family.
cards.exUz: Kutilmagan tibbiy xarajatlar oila uchun katta moliyaviy yuk bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Pul bilan bog'liq muammo yoki majburiyat, og'ir yuk.

cards.ex: We're saving for a down payment on a house.
cards.exUz: Biz uy uchun boshlang'ich to'lovga pul yig'yapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Xaridning boshida to'lanadigan summa, avans.

cards.ex: The government's fiscal policy aims to stimulate economic growth.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning moliya siyosati iqtisodiy o'sishni rag'batlantirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatning daromadlar va xarajatlar bilan bog'liq siyosati.

cards.ex: The country is seeking debt relief from international lenders.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat xalqaro kreditorlardan qarzdan yengillik so'ramoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni to'lash shartlarini yengillashtirish, qarzni kechirish.

cards.ex: Many businesses struggled during the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Ko'p bizneslar iqtisodiy pasayish davrida qiynaldi.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotning yomonlashuvi, pasayishi.

cards.ex: The central bank uses monetary policy to control inflation.
cards.exUz: Markaziy bank inflyatsiyani nazorat qilish uchun pul siyosatidan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Markaziy bankning pul massasini nazorat qilish siyosati.

cards.ex: He made a fortune in the stock market.
cards.exUz: U fond bozorida katta boylik orttirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p pul topish, boy bo'lib ketish.

cards.ex: Her biggest asset is her house.
cards.exUz: Uning eng katta aktivi uyi.
cards.uzDef: Qiymati bor narsa, mulk.

cards.ex: The company has a lot of liabilities.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning ko'plab majburiyatlari bor.
cards.uzDef: Qarz yoki to'lash kerak bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The debt burden is crippling the economy.
cards.exUz: Qarz yuki iqtisodiyotni falaj qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarzning og'irligi, qarzni to'lash qiyinligi.

cards.ex: The hospital is cash-strapped and needs more funding.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona pulga zor va ko'proq mablag'ga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Pulga muhtoj, puli yetishmaydigan.

cards.ex: He's such a penny pincher, he never spends money on anything fun.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik xasiski, hech qachon qiziqarli narsalarga pul sarflamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tejamkor, xarajat qilishni yoqtirmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: After winning the lottery, they started to live large.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada yutgandan so'ng, ular dabdabali yashay boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Boylarcha, hashamatli yashash.

cards.ex: They are quite well-off and can afford to travel.
cards.exUz: Ular juda boy va sayohat qilishga qodir.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi ta'minlangan, puli yetarli bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He lost all his money in a get-rich-quick scheme.
cards.exUz: U tez boyish sxemasida barcha pulini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda pul topishga qaratilgan shubhali reja.

cards.ex: The monetary value of the artwork has increased significantly.
cards.exUz: San'at asarining pul qiymati sezilarli darajada oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning puldagi bahosi.

cards.ex: The country is negotiating debt restructuring with its creditors.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat kreditorlar bilan qarzni qayta tuzish bo'yicha muzokaralar olib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni to'lash shartlarini o'zgartirish, yengillashtirish.

cards.ex: He ran up a lot of debt on his credit cards.
cards.exUz: U kredit kartalarida ko'p qarzga botdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p qarz olish, qarzdor bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: The company's fiscal year ends in June.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliya yili iyunda tugaydi.
cards.uzDef: Budjet hisobotlari uchun ishlatiladigan 12 oylik davr.

cards.ex: He thought he could make easy money with online gambling.
cards.exUz: U onlayn qimor bilan oson pul topishim mumkin deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliksiz topilgan pul.

cards.ex: I'm a bit strapped for cash this month, can I pay you back next week?
cards.exUz: Men bu oy biroz pulga muhtojman, keyingi hafta qaytarsam maylimi?
cards.uzDef: Pulga qattiq muhtojlik his qilish.

cards.ex: The CEO was arrested for cooking the books.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirgani uchun hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirish, aldash.
